item: Feed verification in airplane mode checks nothing and says so, instead of storing a false unreachable verdict (invariant 14e, R296)
refs: PR pending; R296; found by the read of PR #1542
key_paths: src/events/feeds.py src/ingest/fetch_verdict.py src/markets/csv_feeds.py src/api/monitoring.py src/api/events.py src/static/app-agenda.js tests/test_feed_verify_offline.py tests/feed_verify_offline_node_test.js tests/test_consent_coverage.py
summary: verify_feed read the kill switch's refusal as the HOST being unreachable: it stored an unreachable verdict, recorded a ladder attempt (a healthy feed waited a month per rung), the verify-batch endpoint skipped it for good (it selects feeds with no verdict) and the Check button toasted a green Checked. Now a refusal classified offline by the existing classify_fetch_failure returns status skipped_offline and records nothing (no verdict, no attempt), so the feed stays exactly as eligible as before; the single endpoint carries skipped_offline at the top level, the batch counts refusals apart (checked excludes them, verdicts holds only stored ones), verify_due_feeds counts them apart from failed, and feedAction shows the existing airplane-mode warning. Every key is present only when the kill switch caused it; an ordinary failure is unchanged. No new string (the C1 sentence is reused). The two gap rows of tests/test_consent_coverage.py flipped to named. The shared classifier (fetch_verdict.classify_fetch_failure) is also ANCHORED now: it matched the words kill switch ANYWHERE in a failure's text, so a real 503, redirect target or URL that happened to contain them was read as the person's airplane mode (affecting this fix, the collector's ff:offline and C1's skipped_offline); it now needs the fetcher's own sentence at the START (optionally after a class prefix), with control cases pinned where the phrase is INSIDE a real failure. R298: the two other text matchers (markets/csv_feeds classify_fetch_failure, used by markets and weather, and the monitoring health summary) share ONE definition now, is_kill_switch_refusal, which recognises our own sentences at the START of the text (the kill switch's, and the socket guard's airplane mode is engaged, bare or as requests wraps it) and never a phrase inside a remote party's text. 14 mutants killed.
